crm_notes:
Inbound via self-serve signup + quickstart email. Small boutique DTC (women's accessories). Founder (Diane) completed hosted API signup, used free credits to test product Q&A demo. Wants: fast integration with Shopify, cheap embeddings for catalog search, and a chat widget that can answer product/fit questions. Notes from discovery call: 'We need something that just works during flash sales — traffic spikes are real.'

Observed behavior: bursty traffic around weekly drops (2-3x baseline for ~2 hours). Concerned about per-token costs during spikes. Leaning toward hosted API to avoid infra ops. Asked about caching/retry strategies, and whether Redwood has prefix/kv caching.

Security: needs SSO for admin UI (SAML) and audit logs for transactions; not strict on residency but wants clear retention controls. SOC2 is nice-to-have.

Quotation: "If this can reduce search noise and make the cart conversion higher during launches, we can justify the spend."

Slack notes: quick follow-up for pricing worksheet sent 2026-03-03. SE to propose inexpensive embedding size and cold-start mitigation tips.
